sql: with t as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and action='buy') select 'pairs' k, string_agg(twin_tag||'|'||coalesce(ended_at::text,'open')||'|'||started_at::text, ', ') v from live_paper_twins where live_tag='Alimm1' union all select 'tickers', count(*)::text from t union all select 'orders', count(*)::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' union all select 'first_order', min(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' union all select 'pos_rows', count(*)::text from positions p join t using(market_ticker) union all select 'flat_pos_rows', count(*)::text from positions p join t using(market_ticker) where quantity=0 union all select 'fills', count(*)::text from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' union all select 'snapshots', count(*)::text from incentive_market_snapshots s join t using(market_ticker) union all select 'bal_obs', count(*)::text||' '||min(at)::text from incentive_balance_observations union all select 'cancel_reasons', string_agg(distinct coalesce(split_part(cancel_reason,':',1),'null'), ',') from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' union all select 'first_'||split_part(cancel_reason,':',1), min(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and cancel_reason is not null group by 1 union all select 'first_limmsell', min(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and client_order_id like 'limmsell:%'
